import numpy as np
class CMA:
 def __init__(self,x,sigma,pop=24,seed=1):
  self.mean=np.array(x,dtype=float);self.n=n=len(x);self.sigma=sigma;self.pop=pop;self.mu=pop//2;self.rng=np.random.default_rng(seed)
  w=np.log(self.mu+.5)-np.log(np.arange(1,self.mu+1));self.w=w/w.sum();self.mueff=1/np.sum(self.w**2)
  me=self.mueff;self.cc=(4+me/n)/(n+4+2*me/n);self.cs=(me+2)/(n+me+5);self.c1=2/((n+1.3)**2+me);self.cmu=min(1-self.c1,2*(me-2+1/me)/((n+2)**2+me));self.damps=1+2*max(0,np.sqrt((me-1)/(n+1))-1)+self.cs
  self.pc=np.zeros(n);self.ps=np.zeros(n);self.C=np.eye(n);self.gen=0;self.best=(np.inf,self.mean.copy());self.chi=np.sqrt(n)*(1-1/(4*n)+1/(21*n*n))
 def ask(self):
  v,b=np.linalg.eigh(self.C);self.B=b;self.D=np.sqrt(np.maximum(v,1e-20));self.inv=(b/self.D)@b.T
  self.y=(self.rng.normal(size=(self.pop,self.n))*self.D)@b.T
  return self.mean+self.sigma*self.y
 def tell(self,x,f):
  self.gen+=1;i=np.argsort(f);x=np.asarray(x);f=np.asarray(f)
  if f[i[0]]<self.best[0]:self.best=(f[i[0]],x[i[0]].copy())
  y=(x[i[:self.mu]]-self.mean)/self.sigma;yw=self.w@y;self.mean+=self.sigma*yw
  self.ps=(1-self.cs)*self.ps+np.sqrt(self.cs*(2-self.cs)*self.mueff)*(self.inv@yw)
  h=np.linalg.norm(self.ps)/np.sqrt(1-(1-self.cs)**(2*self.gen))/self.chi<1.4+2/(self.n+1)
  self.pc=(1-self.cc)*self.pc+h*np.sqrt(self.cc*(2-self.cc)*self.mueff)*yw
  self.C=(1-self.c1-self.cmu+(1-h)*self.c1*self.cc*(2-self.cc))*self.C+self.c1*np.outer(self.pc,self.pc)+self.cmu*(y.T*self.w)@y
  self.sigma*=np.exp(self.cs/self.damps*(np.linalg.norm(self.ps)/self.chi-1))
